title: Methodological and Conceptual Framework for 5D Multi-Table Analysis: A Unified Approach for Complex Data Reuse
abstract: arXiv:2608.26149v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Multi-table learning remains a major challenge in machine learning for healthcare and other complex information systems. Relational data combine several sources of complexity, including large data volume, high-dimensional variables, high-cardinality categorical features, complex inter-table dependencies, and repeated temporal observations. We introduce the Relational Hypergraph Transformer (RHT), a unified architecture that represents relational databases as hypergraphs, learns pentadimensional embeddings (PentE), and performs sparse relational attention with complexity proportional to the average relational degree rather than the square of the number of entities. We formally define the architecture, derive the complexity of its attention mechanism, and provide an open-source reference implementation. We evaluate RHT on the public Synthea synthetic electronic health record dataset using multi-label prediction of SNOMED CT condition codes

translated_title: 5D多表分析的方法论与概念框架：一种复杂数据复用的统一方法
translated_abstract: 多表学习仍然是机器学习和复杂信息系统（如医疗保健）中的一项重大挑战。关系数据结合了多种复杂性来源，包括大数据量、高维变量、高基数分类特征、复杂的表间依赖关系以及重复的时间观测。我们引入了关系超图变换器（RHT），这是一种统一架构，将关系数据库表示为超图，学习五维嵌入（PentE），并执行稀疏关系注意力，其复杂度与平均关系度成正比，而非实体数量的平方。我们正式定义了该架构，推导出其注意力机制的复杂度，并提供了开源参考实现。我们在公开的Synthea合成电子健康记录数据集上，使用SNOMED CT条件码的多标签预测评估了RHT。
tldr: 本文提出了一种名为关系超图变换器（RHT）的统一架构，通过超图表示和五维嵌入，实现了高效处理复杂关系数据的方法，显著降低了计算复杂度。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces the Relational Hypergraph Transformer (RHT), a unified architecture that represents relational databases as hypergraphs with pentadimensional embeddings, enabling efficient handling of complex relational data with reduced computational complexity.
